title: Disclaimer
description: Terms and limitations of Pikaleads’ liability for the information on this website and for the advertising and marketing services we provide.

By using the Website and ordering our services, you confirm that you have read and accept the terms of this disclaimer.

All information on the Website (texts, case studies, blog articles, figures and estimates) is of a general informational nature and does not constitute individual advice, a guarantee of results, a public offer or legal advice, unless expressly stated otherwise. The specific terms of cooperation are set out in the contract and its annexes.
2. No guarantee of specific results

The effectiveness of advertising depends on many factors beyond the Agency’s full control: the client’s niche and product, the quality of the website and offer, budget, seasonality, competition, audience behavior and the algorithms of advertising platforms. The figures in case studies and commercial materials (cost per lead, lead volume, ROAS, conversions) reflect the results of specific projects over a specific period and do not guarantee similar results for other clients. Forecasts and “estimated” figures are indicative only.

The Agency is not liable for lost profits resulting from the client’s untimely processing of leads.

3.3. The advertising platforms’ responsibility. Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and other platforms are independent services with their own rules. The Agency does not control and is not responsible for their actions: suspensions and restrictions of ad accounts, rejection of ads in review, changes to algorithms, pricing and policies, technical failures, or fluctuations in the cost of impressions and clicks caused by the auction model.

For regulated and sensitive niches (healthcare, finance, 18+, iGaming, dietary supplements, etc.), the client independently confirms that it holds the necessary licenses and permits and complies with the requirements of the jurisdictions in which advertising is run.
